The '''Hills of Absher''' are located in western [[Andor]] and make up some of the territory between [[Baerlon]] and [[Whitebridge]]. 

==Events==
A large force of [[Shadowspawn]] used the geography of the hills to their advantage in their initial pursuit of [[Rand al'Thor]] and his companions from the [[Two Rivers]], driving them away from the road and eventually forcing them to take refuge in the ruined city of [[Shadar Logoth]] to the north.

==Geographical Information==
* [[Rand al'Thor]] recalls seeing [[Bran al'Vere]]'s old map showing that the [[Caemlyn Road]] "curved around something called the Hills of Absher". 
* When [[Perrin Aybara]] suggests making a direct path from the Caemlyn Road to Whitebridge to escape the Trollocs pursuing them, [[Moiraine Damodred]] says that progress would be slow through the Hills and that they would eventually have to meet up again with the Caemlyn Road before reaching Whitebridge. 
* Moiraine informs the group of two choice, north or south, saying "to the south are the Hills of Absher, barren and dead, and the [[Taren]], with no way to cross, and no traffic by boat. 

This location is only mentioned in [[The Eye of the World/Chapter 18]].
